A '''battle''' between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], and the [[Coronas]] gang under Councilor [[Harmon Torvix]] occurred on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] after the [[Battle of Corellia]], as the three forces fought for control of the [[Black Hole (Corellia)|Black Hole]] hypermatter refinery.
